items.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Apple and Palantir Technologies
items.summary: Apple and Palantir Technologies both retreated roughly 2% on Tuesday despite delivering impressive quarterly results. Apple reported record Q4 and FY26 results with strong iPhone and Services revenue growth, while Palantir showed explosive AI-driven growth with 96% revenue increase. Both stocks received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, with Apple offering better stability through reasonable valuation and exceptional free cash flow, while Palantir presents greater growth potential but trades at a lofty valuation.

items.title: L3Harris: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: L3Harris reported strong Q3 2026 results with 9% organic revenue growth and a record $53 billion backlog, driven by $11 billion in missile program contracts. The company is leveraging automation and AI to accelerate production while shifting focus from acquisitions to internal execution and debt reduction, positioning itself well for sustained defense spending.

items.title: Realty Income: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Realty Income raised its 2026 AFFO guidance to $4.45-$4.46 per share while maintaining its $10 billion annual investment target. The company is diversifying its strategy through European real estate investments (7.1% yield), credit investments in high-rate environments, and alternative capital sources to reduce reliance on public equity issuance. This multi-pronged approach allows the company to preserve investment spreads and drive sustainable per-share growth.

items.title: Nokia vs. AT&T: Comparing Cyclical Sales Patterns vs. Steady Revenue
items.summary: AT&T generates roughly five times more revenue than Nokia with consistent quarter-over-quarter performance, while Nokia exhibits cyclical patterns with sharp Q4 spikes reflecting IT budget spending cycles. Both companies show year-over-year growth, but Nokia's AI and cloud business is accelerating with 123% growth, potentially transforming its revenue trajectory. AT&T's steady free cash flow supports its dividend payments, demonstrating reliable operational performance.

items.title: The Ensign Group, Inc. Notice of December 7, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announces a class action securities lawsuit against The Ensign Group, Inc. for investors who purchased shares between February 10, 2022 and June 18, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Ensign made materially false statements and failed to disclose systematic neglect of elderly residents, abuse, Medicaid/Medicare fraud, falsification of nursing assistant hours, and illegal licensing schemes. The application deadline to request lead plaintiff status is December 7, 2026.

items.title: Everest Group, Ltd. Notice of December 28, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announces a class action securities lawsuit against Everest Group, Ltd. for investors who purchased stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025. The lawsuit alleges that Everest made materially false statements about its Insurance division's casualty reserves. In October 2025, the company disclosed $478 million in unfavorable prior year reserve development and secured $1.2 billion in protection against further adverse development. The stock price fell 11.4% following the disclosure. The application deadline to request lead plaintiff status is December 28, 2026.

items.title: Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. Notice of November 23, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announced multiple class action securities lawsuits against publicly traded companies. Honeywell Aerospace faces allegations of failing to disclose supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, cybersecurity investigation, and making misleading statements about business prospects. The Ensign Group and Duolingo also have pending securities fraud lawsuits with application deadlines in December 2026.

items.title: Nike vs. Procter & Gamble: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: The article compares Nike and Procter & Gamble as investment options for 2027. Nike trades at a premium valuation (32.2x forward P/E) despite slowing revenue growth, though it offers an attractive 4.19% dividend yield and is on track to become a Dividend King. Procter & Gamble offers more defensive positioning with essential household goods, a lower valuation (23.2x forward P/E), and is already a Dividend King with 70 consecutive years of dividend increases. The author recommends P&G over Nike, citing P&G's superior 2026 performance (+14.1% vs Nike's -38.6%) and more stable business model.

items.title: BigBear.ai vs. Nebius: Which AI Stock Is the Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: The article compares two AI stocks: BigBear.ai, which provides defense-focused decision-intelligence software but faces declining revenue and significant losses, versus Nebius, a cloud infrastructure company experiencing explosive 444% revenue growth and recent profitability. The author recommends Nebius for 2027 despite its high valuation multiples and recent 38% stock decline, citing its scarce, high-demand infrastructure assets and strong earnings trajectory.

items.title: Sysco: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Sysco reported Q1 FY2027 earnings with adjusted EPS of $1.19 and announced three key initiatives: an AI transformation program targeting $100 million in cost savings for FY2027 and $500 million by FY2029, the pending acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot expected to close by Q3 FY2027, and local case volume growth of 2.7% despite a 2% decline in broader restaurant industry traffic. The company is leveraging technology and strategic acquisitions to drive margin expansion in the second half of the year.

items.title: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Bank of America Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BAC
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America Corporation for allegedly failing to disclose systemic weaknesses in its Bank of America, N.A. subsidiary's BSA/AML compliance program, which caused it to improperly monitor trillions in transactions and file inaccurate suspicious activity reports. The lawsuit also alleges deficiencies in sanctions compliance programs. Investors who purchased BAC stock between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with a December 15, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

items.title: AMD EPS: Intel's Drag Makes No Sense
items.summary: Intel's stock plunged 28% after reporting strong earnings but disappointing guidance of $15-16B versus Wall Street's $17.1B estimate. The decline stems from a severe PC market downturn, with expected unit shipments dropping 12% in 2026 and 10% in 2027. In contrast, AMD is thriving with 74% revenue growth and shifting toward an AI-first company, with data center expected to account for over 80% of revenue by 2027. Intel's supply-demand imbalance in the expanding server CPU market presents an opportunity for AMD to gain market share.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Honeywell Aerospace Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – HONA
items.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Honeywell Aerospace Inc. and Fluence Energy, Inc., alleging securities fraud and unlawful business practices. Honeywell Aerospace experienced significant stock declines following disappointing Q2 2026 earnings (70% net income drop) and guidance cuts, followed by a $2 million DOJ settlement for cybersecurity compliance failures on a defense contract.

items.title: Pomerantz Law Firm Announces the Filing of a Class Action Against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. and Certain Officers – ASTS
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. and certain officers for alleged violations of federal securities laws. The complaint alleges that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding the company's competitive position in the satellite direct-to-cellular market, capital sufficiency, and user adoption rates, particularly following SpaceX's entry into the market through the EchoStar transaction. The class period spans March 4, 2025 to July 15, 2026.

items.title: APPLOVIN DEADLINE: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased APP securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

items.title: Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Tops Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Skyworks Solutions reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.28 per share, slightly beating consensus estimates of $1.27, with revenues of $1.05 billion. However, the company faces a mixed earnings outlook and operates in an industry ranked in the bottom 12% of Zacks industries. The stock received a Hold rating and is expected to perform in line with the market.

items.title: QuidelOrtho (QDEL) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: QuidelOrtho reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.31 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.18 by 72%, though revenues slightly missed expectations at $618.9M. Despite the earnings beat, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revision trends. The stock has underperformed the market by 50.9% year-to-date, and the Medical-Products industry ranks in the bottom 35% of Zacks industries.

items.title: Prudential (PRU) Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates
items.summary: Prudential reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.77 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.31 by 13.90%, but revenues of $13.49 billion missed expectations by 3.35%. Despite the earnings beat, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revision trends. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date, gaining 4.8% versus the market's 10.2% gain.

items.title: Duolingo, Inc. (DUOL) Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates
items.summary: Duolingo reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.54 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $0.55, though revenues of $309.01 million exceeded expectations by 1.43%. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 33.1% year-to-date and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

items.title: Leidos' Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Miss, '26 EPS View Raised
items.summary: Leidos Holdings reported Q3 2026 non-GAAP EPS of $3.62, beating estimates by 19.1%, but revenues of $4.63B missed forecasts. The company raised 2026 EPS guidance to $12.50-$12.70 and operating cash flow to $1.9B, though it cut revenue outlook to $18.00-$18.20B. Homeland segment revenues surged 32.1% while Health segment declined 11.7%. The company maintains a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AppLovin Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims that between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026, AppLovin made false and misleading statements regarding its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased AppLovin securities during this period are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 16, 2026.

items.title: Amazon's Earnings Just Hit a Record. So Why Is the Stock Down 11% From Its Peak?
items.summary: Amazon reported record earnings with AWS revenue up 39% to $46 billion and strong e-commerce margins, but the stock fell 11% from its peak due to investor concerns about negative free cash flow from $220 billion in AI capital expenditures and slowing North American e-commerce growth. However, the e-commerce slowdown was largely due to a Prime Day scheduling shift, and the company's long-term growth prospects remain strong with potential for significant earnings expansion.

items.title: Palantir Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Sovereign AI Demand and Outlook
items.summary: Palantir Technologies raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $8.53B, representing 91% year-over-year growth, driven by accelerating enterprise adoption of sovereign AI. U.S. commercial revenue surged 148% to $984M, surpassing government revenues for the first time. The company reported Q3 adjusted earnings of $0.44 per share and a 62% operating margin, with strong demand for AI-driven operational workflows and defense deployments.

items.title: Healthpeak's Q3 FFOA Beat Estimates on Leasing, Senior Housing Growth
items.summary: Healthpeak Properties (DOC) reported Q3 2026 FFOA of $0.44 per share, beating estimates by 2.3%, with revenues up 16.3% YoY to $820.9 million. The company raised 2026 FFOA guidance to $1.76-$1.78 per share, supported by solid outpatient leasing, improving lab occupancy, and strong senior housing performance from Janus Living. However, operating expenses surged 30% YoY, and the company carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

items.title: Vertex Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Revenue Beat and Pipeline Expansion
items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals reported Q3 2026 revenues of $3.44 billion, beating estimates by 1.2% with 12% year-over-year growth driven by its CF franchise and newer therapies like CASGEVY and JOURNAVX. However, earnings missed consensus at $4.76 per share due to higher operating expenses and acquisition costs from the Crinetics Pharmaceuticals deal. The company raised full-year revenue guidance to $13.15-$13.25 billion and highlighted an upcoming FDA decision on povetacicept for kidney disease on November 30, 2026.

items.title: Realty Income Has Paid 676 Consecutive Monthly Dividends. Here’s How Its Earnings Results Fit the Bigger Picture.
items.summary: Realty Income reported Q3 2026 earnings with AFFO up 3.7% to $1.12 per share and raised full-year guidance to $4.45-$4.46. The REIT maintains a 73% dividend payout ratio, invested $2.6 billion in the quarter at 6.8% yield, and continues its 56-year streak of consecutive monthly dividends supported by a diversified tenant base and 96%+ occupancy rates.

items.title: Pinnacle West Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Sales Growth
items.summary: Pinnacle West Capital (PNW) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.49 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.40, with revenues rising 8.3% to $1.97 billion. Operating income grew 6.7% driven by higher electricity sales, favorable weather, and customer growth. The company maintains 2026 EPS guidance of $5.05-$5.25 and projects 8-10% weather-normalized retail sales growth.

items.title: SBAC Q3 FFO Top Estimates on International Leasing Gains
items.summary: SBA Communications (SBAC) reported Q3 FFO of $3.19 per share, beating estimates by 3.6%, though down 3.3% year-over-year. International site-leasing revenues grew 13.3%, but domestic leasing declined 3.4% due to Sprint and EchoStar churn. The company lowered 2026 revenue guidance but raised AFFO per-share guidance midpoint by 8 cents. SBAC carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.title: Valero to Acquire Houston Refining Site, Plans 165,000 BPD Restart
items.summary: Valero Energy has agreed to acquire a 100% equity stake in LYB Houston Hub Holdings LLC from LyondellBasell Industries for $320.5 million. The acquisition includes a 700-acre facility adjacent to Valero's existing Houston refinery, with plans to restart 165,000 barrels per day of light sweet crude processing capacity by late 2027. The deal also provides Valero with options to invest in heavy sour crude processing infrastructure, leveraging its existing expertise in processing discounted heavy crude grades.

items.title: Keurig Dr Pepper Q3 Earnings Beat on Beverage Growth, Sales Miss
items.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of 66 cents, beating estimates, with net sales of $7.3 billion missing expectations. The company's U.S. Refreshment Beverages segment grew 10.9% while U.S. Coffee operating income advanced 11.4%, supported by the JDE Peet's acquisition. KDP reaffirmed 2026 sales guidance of $25.9-$26.4 billion but narrowed legacy EPS growth expectations to 3-5%.

items.title: CoreWeave's 15% Bond Yield Is a Warning for AI Debt. Here Are the Stocks Most Exposed.
items.summary: CoreWeave, a rapidly growing AI infrastructure provider, is raising red flags with its 15% bond yields and high leverage (debt-to-equity ratio of 14.3), despite strong revenue growth. The company spends a quarter of its revenue on interest payments and faces potential refinancing challenges if rates continue rising. While competitors like Nebius and IREN have lower leverage, CoreWeave's financial stress could impact the broader neocloud sector's ability to secure affordable financing.

items.title: Netflix Trades at a Discount to the S&P 500's Valuation. Is It Deserved?
items.summary: Netflix stock has fallen 54% from its all-time high, now trading at a discount to the S&P 500 for the first time in its history. The decline is driven by slowing revenue growth and disappointing guidance. However, the author argues the discount is unwarranted, citing Netflix's strong historical recovery patterns and attractive forward valuations of 14-12x earnings for 2028-2029.

items.title: Costco Hasn't Split Its Stock Since 2000. Here's Why 2027 Could Be the Year.
items.summary: With Costco's stock trading above $1,000 per share for the first time since its last split in 2000, a potential stock split in 2027 could make the stock more accessible to retail investors. While a split wouldn't change the company's underlying valuation, Costco's strong fundamentals—including its membership model, consistent earnings growth, and international expansion opportunities—make it an attractive long-term holding regardless of share price.

items.title: Aptiv Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates Amid Non-Auto Growth
items.summary: Aptiv (APTV) beat Q3 earnings expectations with $1.42 EPS and $3.20B in revenues, driven by strong Engineered Components growth. However, the company faces margin pressures from commodity costs and material inflation, leading to reduced free cash flow guidance for 2026. The stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating, having declined 45.3% over the past year.

items.title: Devon Energy to Report Q3 Earnings: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: Devon Energy (DVN) is set to report Q3 2026 earnings on November 5 with consensus estimates of $1.24 per share and $7.33B in revenues. The company is expected to beat estimates due to strong Delaware Basin production, full-quarter contributions from the Coterra merger, operational efficiencies, and over 350 identified synergy initiatives. DVN trades at a discount valuation of 8.98X forward earnings versus the industry average of 10.75X, with a strong balance sheet featuring only 21.43% debt-to-capital ratio.

items.title: RVTY Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Life Sciences Strength, '26 View Up
items.summary: Revvity (RVTY) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.38, beating estimates by 7%, with revenues rising 4.3% to $728.9M. Life Sciences revenues climbed 10.7% driven by strong pharma and biotech demand. The company raised its 2026 pro forma EPS guidance to $5.40-$5.45 and revenue forecast to $2.86B, reflecting 6% total growth and 5% organic growth.

items.title: What Makes Altria (MO) a Strong Momentum Stock: Buy Now?
items.summary: Altria (MO) has earned a Zacks Momentum Style Score of A and a #2 (Buy) rating, driven by strong short-term and long-term price performance that outpaces both its industry and the broader market. Recent earnings estimate revisions have been positive, with upward movements in both current and next fiscal year estimates, supporting the bullish outlook for the tobacco company.

items.title: Eaton Q3 Earnings Top Estimates on Strong Organic Sales, View Up
items.summary: Eaton Corporation (ETN) delivered robust third-quarter results with adjusted EPS of $3.68 (up 19.9%) and revenues of $8.95 billion (up 28%), driven by strong electrical demand and a 65% surge in data center revenues. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $13.70-$13.80 and organic growth guidance to 13-15%, while achieving record segment operating margins of 25.3%. The company also announced plans to acquire COL Group for $921 million and separate its Mobility business in 2027.

items.title: MARUY or HON: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
items.summary: A comparison of two Diversified Operations sector stocks reveals that Marubeni Corp. (MARUY) presents a better value opportunity than Honeywell International Inc. (HON). MARUY has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with improving earnings outlook, a lower forward P/E ratio of 12.23 versus HON's 26.52, and a Value grade of A compared to HON's C grade.

items.title: Archer Daniels Q3 Earnings Beat on Biofuel Strength, Revenues Miss
items.summary: Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.77, up 92.4% YoY and beating consensus estimates by 8.6%, driven by strong biofuel margins and robust ethanol economics. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.50-$5.80 from $5.15-$5.60, citing favorable biofuel conditions and increased domestic demand. However, revenues of $22.34 billion missed forecasts slightly.

items.title: Can Quanta's Record Backlog Support Its 2027 Double-Digit EPS Growth?
items.summary: Quanta Services (PWR) reported a record backlog of $63.73 billion, up 62.7% year-over-year, with third-quarter adjusted EPS jumping to $6.06. The company raised its 2026 EPS guidance and expects strong double-digit adjusted EPS growth in 2027, supported by workforce investments and rising power infrastructure demand. PWR stock has gained 47.2% YTD and currently trades at a premium valuation with a forward P/E of 32.64.

items.title: Procter & Gamble(PG.US) Officer Sells US$6.31 Million in Common Stock - Moomoo
items.summary: Procter & Gamble(PG.US) Officer Sells US$6.31 Million in Common Stock    Moomoo

items.title: Why Intel Stock Collapsed 23.4% Last Month
items.summary: Intel stock fell 23.4% in October due to weak PC market demand and concerns about its foundry business. While the company's AI and data center segment grew 78%, the traditional PC business declined 5%. The foundry business, despite 58% revenue growth, is losing over $1 billion per quarter and underperforming expectations compared to competitors. With a P/S ratio of 5.3 and facing headwinds, the stock appears overvalued for current growth prospects.

items.title: Seagate's $1.2 Billion Debt Paydown: What Comes Next for Investors?
items.summary: Seagate Technology (STX) has significantly improved its financial position by retiring $1.95B in debt across fiscal Q1 2027 and post-quarter, reducing net leverage to 0.2x and principal debt to $1.6B. The company generated $1.5B in free cash flow, returned $568M to shareholders with a 3% dividend increase, and plans to accelerate buybacks in 2027 with $4.4B authorization remaining. Management expects fiscal Q2 revenues of $4.8B (+/-$100M), representing 70% year-over-year growth, supported by strong cloud storage demand and HAMR technology adoption.

items.title: Rockwell Automation Gears Up to Report Q4 Earnings: What to Expect?
items.summary: Rockwell Automation is expected to report Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings on Nov. 5 with projected 6.3% earnings growth and 3.1% sales growth. The company's performance is anticipated to be supported by pricing actions to offset tariffs and inflation, with organic sales growth expected at 3.5%. However, margin headwinds from inflationary pressures on components and commodities may pose challenges. The stock has outperformed its industry by 11.2% over the past year.

items.title: Fiserv Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Decline Y/Y
items.summary: Fiserv beat Q3 earnings estimates with adjusted EPS of $1.75 vs. consensus of $1.72, though earnings declined 14% year-over-year. The company faces significant profitability pressure with adjusted operating margins contracting 580 basis points to 31.2%, driven by weakness in Merchant Solutions revenues (down 3%) and higher transformation costs. Despite challenges, Fiserv reaffirmed its 2026 EPS guidance of $7.20-$7.40 and doubled its Project Elevate cost-savings target to $1 billion.

items.title: Gartner Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Move Up 2% Y/Y
items.summary: Gartner (IT) delivered better-than-expected Q3 2026 results with adjusted EPS of $3.59 (beating estimates by 25.5%) and revenues of $1.51B. The company raised its 2026 guidance, projecting revenues of at least $6.405B and adjusted EPS of at least $14.65. Global contract value grew 2.5% year-over-year, with Conferences segment leading growth at 15.4%. However, Gartner carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

items.title: Clorox Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher Sales & Cost Savings
items.summary: Clorox (CLX) delivered impressive Q1 fiscal 2027 results with adjusted EPS surging 82% year-over-year to $1.55 and net sales jumping 33% to $1.91B, both beating consensus estimates. However, gross margins contracted 130 basis points due to elevated commodity, manufacturing, and logistics costs. The company maintained full-year earnings guidance of $5.70-$6.00 per share but lowered gross margin expectations to 41.5%, with management expecting results near the lower end of guidance.

items.title: What's behind Cboe Global Markets's latest 3.4% stock pullback? - Traders Union
items.summary: What's behind Cboe Global Markets's latest 3.4% stock pullback?    Traders Union

items.title: Why Shares of Alphabet Stock Sank 17.5% Last Month
items.summary: Alphabet's stock fell 17.5% despite strong Q3 earnings (25% revenue growth, $127.6B total revenue) due to investor concerns about Google Search losing market share to AI competitors like ChatGPT and Claude. Additional worries include $51B in Q3 capital expenditures leading to negative free cash flow and uncertainty about monetizing AI features compared to traditional search advertising. However, the stock now trades at a cheaper valuation (21x EV/EBIT) and Google Cloud is growing rapidly at 103% year-over-year.

items.title: Marathon Petroleum Refining Margin Jumps 160%: Rapid Earnings Reaction
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum reported third-quarter net income of $7.4 billion with adjusted EPS of $26.93, up dramatically from $3.01 a year ago, driven primarily by higher refining margins rather than increased volume or lower costs. The company provided no fourth-quarter margin outlook and expects lower throughput, suggesting the exceptional margins may not persist. While the company is returning cash rapidly, profits are heavily dependent on wide refining margins remaining stable.

items.title: Fiserv Takes $6.45B Charge as Margins Shrink: Rapid Earnings Reaction
items.summary: Fiserv reported a $6.45 billion non-cash goodwill write-down in Q3, resulting in a GAAP loss of $11.17 per share. Adjusted earnings fell to $1.75 from $2.04 while organic revenue remained flat, with the Merchant Solutions segment driving most of the operating profit decline. The company maintained full-year guidance but faces pressure as costs rise while sales stall, requiring a strong fourth quarter to meet targets.

items.title: Intel Drops 31% in a Day as Data Center Sales Jump 78%
items.summary: Intel's stock plummeted 31% following weak PC sales guidance and a factory accident in Israel, despite strong data center segment performance with 78% revenue growth. The company now generates most of its profit from data center and AI segments ($3B operating profit) rather than client computing ($2.3B). Management projects the server CPU market could grow fivefold to over $200 billion within five years, but near-term PC weakness and high valuation (42x forward earnings) may limit upside.

items.title: Realty Income Q3 Earnings Call Centers on Funding Flexibility
items.summary: Realty Income raised its 2026 AFFO guidance to $4.45-$4.46 per share and maintained its $10 billion investment target. The company is diversifying beyond U.S. retail by expanding European industrial investments, reducing reliance on public equity funding, and exploring credit investments and asset sales. Management emphasized flexibility in capital sourcing and geographic diversification to achieve per-share growth amid higher interest rates and refinancing challenges.

items.title: Fabrinet Q1 Earnings Call Highlights Capacity Expansion and AI Demand
items.summary: Fabrinet (FN) reported Q1 fiscal 2027 revenues of $1.47 billion, up 51% year-over-year, with data center sales surging 78% to $777 million. The company projects Q2 revenues of $1.6-$1.65 billion and plans to expand annual revenue capacity to $10 billion by January 2027. Management highlighted emerging opportunities in optical circuit switching and near-packaged optics (NPO), expected to contribute in H2 FY27.

items.title: CLX Q1 Earnings Call Highlights Inflation and Margin Pressures
items.summary: Clorox (CLX) maintained its fiscal 2027 sales growth guidance of 13-14% but expects EPS near the low end of its range due to increased input cost inflation of $240 million. The company is targeting margin recovery through selective pricing, productivity gains, and $50 million in GOJO cost synergies. First-quarter results beat expectations with revenues of $1.91 billion and adjusted EPS of $1.55, though gross margins declined 130 basis points year-over-year to 40.4%.

items.title: Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Investors With Losses May Seek to Lead the Class Action in Baidu, Inc. Securities Lawsuit - Contact Portnoy Law Firm
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Baidu, Inc. for allegedly misleading investors about its AI business's ability to offset declines in legacy revenue streams. The lawsuit covers the period from November 18, 2025 to August 17, 2026, during which Baidu's stock experienced significant drops following disappointing financial results and regulatory disclosures. Investors with losses during this period can seek appointment as lead plaintiff by November 13, 2026.

items.title: AAPL Q4 Earnings Call Highlights Supply Risks and AI Investment
items.summary: Apple expects December-quarter revenues to grow 7-10% year-over-year with gross margins between 45-46%, projecting record quarterly revenue. However, the company faces headwinds from unprecedented memory cost inflation, supply constraints, and increased AI processing expenses from Siri expansion. Strong iPhone demand and services growth provide support, but margin pressures are expected to persist.

items.title: Viatris Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: Is a Beat in the Cards?
items.summary: Viatris (VTRS) is expected to report Q3 2026 revenues of $3.78 billion and earnings of 64 cents per share, likely beating consensus estimates. The company faces headwinds from FDA import alerts affecting 11 products, supply disruptions, and competitive pressures, but these are expected to be offset by new product growth and strength in branded markets, particularly in Greater China and Emerging Markets.

items.title: Here's My Top Stock to Buy for November
items.summary: Boeing is recommended as a value stock with significant upside potential despite recent execution disappointments. The company's three business segments show promise: Boeing Global Services generates solid earnings, Boeing Defense Space & Security has returned to profitability after working through problematic fixed-price contracts, and Boeing Commercial Airplanes is ramping up 737 MAX production with 777X certification expected in 2027. Management's free cash flow guidance may be conservative, with potential to reach $10 billion normalized FCF by 2029.

items.title: Is Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) Outperforming Other Business Services Stocks This Year?

items.summary: Tempus AI (TEM) reported quarterly earnings of $0.07 per share, beating consensus estimates of a loss of $0.09, representing a 177.78% earnings surprise. The company posted revenues of $411.54 million, surpassing estimates by 0.05% and showing year-over-year growth from $334.21 million. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. The Medical Info Systems industry ranks in the top 36% of Zacks industries.

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges The Ensign Group, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against The Ensign Group, Inc. alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its business operations. The complaint claims Ensign's business model depends on systematic neglect of elderly residents in its facilities, including inadequate food, medical attention, and basic care, resulting in resident deaths. Additional allegations include fraudulent billing to Medicaid and Medicare, falsification of nursing assistant hours, and illegal licensing schemes. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased Ensign securities between February 10, 2022 and June 18, 2026.

items.title: Can Dollar General's Media Network Become a Major Margin Driver?
items.summary: Dollar General's media network achieved $170 million in annual volume by end of fiscal 2025 with expectations for meaningful growth. The company is expanding advertising across digital and physical channels including search, sponsored products, in-store radio, and off-site advertising. DG plans to pilot loyalty and subscription programs in late 2026 with broader rollout in 2027. The retail media business is positioned as a key driver for gross margin improvement.

items.title: Cadence's Raised 2026 Outlook Tests the Strength of Its AI Demand
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $6.387-$6.417 billion and non-GAAP EPS guidance to $8.37-$8.43, driven by strong Q3 results, record $8.2 billion backlog, and expanding AI Super Agents adoption across 100+ customer engagements. However, margin pressure persists as operating costs rose 30%, outpacing 22% revenue growth, with non-GAAP operating margin contracting to 44.1% from 47.6% year-over-year.

items.title: Can Cadence's AI Momentum Offset Margin Pressure and Rich Valuation?
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems reported strong Q3 results with 22% revenue growth to $1.633 billion and a record $8.2 billion backlog, driven by AI-related design demand. However, the stock trades at a premium 34.4X forward earnings with declining operating margins (44.1% vs 47.6% year-over-year) due to increased costs and acquisition integration risks. While cash flow remains robust, the valuation leaves limited room for execution errors.

items.title: LyondellBasell to Sell Former Houston Refinery Site for $320.5M
items.summary: LyondellBasell Industries has agreed to sell its former Houston Refinery site and related assets to Valero Energy for $320.5 million. The transaction, expected to close in Q4 2026, is part of LYB's portfolio streamlining strategy. Valero will assume site operations, environmental liabilities, and employee obligations, while the sale allows LYB to divest non-core assets and improve capital allocation.

items.title: PEG Q3 Earnings Miss Expectations, Revenues Decrease Y/Y
items.summary: Public Service Enterprise Group (PSEG) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.15, missing consensus estimates by 5%, with revenues declining 6.4% to $3.02 billion. Despite a 27.3% drop in operating income, the company reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $4.28-$4.40. Electric and gas sales showed mixed trends, while nuclear generation increased. The company carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.title: STX Falls 24.1% in the Past Month as Risks Test AI Storage Momentum
items.summary: Seagate Technology (STX) shares declined 24.1% over the past month despite posting strong fiscal Q1 2027 results with 61% revenue growth and significant data center expansion. The stock trades at a premium valuation (13.97X forward earnings) compared to its industry peers, raising concerns about execution risks, particularly around HAMR technology qualification and customer concentration in data centers.

items.title: Seagate Q2 Outlook Signals Stronger Growth as HAMR Ramp Accelerates
items.summary: Seagate Technology (STX) is entering its fiscal Q2 with strong growth prospects driven by higher cloud storage demand, favorable pricing, and heat-assisted magnetic recording (HAMR) technology expansion. The company projects Q2 revenues of $4.8 billion and earnings of $9.20 per share, with operating margins expected to reach the mid-50s. Long-term supply agreements through 2028-2030 provide demand visibility, though execution risks around product qualifications and manufacturing transitions remain key concerns.

items.title: If Moderna's CEO Is Right, the Stock's Rally Could Just Be Getting Started
items.summary: Moderna's stock has surged 650% in 2026, driven by excitement around its cancer vaccine intismeran developed with Merck. Recent trials showed the vaccine reduced melanoma death/recurrence risk by 42% when combined with Merck's Keytruda. CEO Stéphane Bancel believes intismeran could work across multiple cancer types where Keytruda is effective, potentially unlocking significant growth. However, the stock faces sky-high expectations and intismeran remains unapproved, warranting cautious investor approach.

items.title: AMETEK to Post Q3 Earnings: Time to Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: AMETEK is scheduled to report Q3 2026 results on November 3, with guidance of $2.08-$2.10 adjusted EPS slightly below the consensus estimate of $2.12. The company is expected to benefit from record orders and backlog, strong demand across aerospace, defense, semiconductor and automation markets, and contributions from the $5 billion Indicor acquisition. Pricing initiatives and productivity gains should support profitability, though integration costs may impact near-term earnings.

items.title: GD Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Raised Outlook and Record Backlog
items.summary: General Dynamics (GD) raised its 2026 EPS guidance to $17.2-$17.3 and revenue guidance to $56.5B-$56.8B following strong Q3 execution. The company reported record $220.3B backlog, with Marine Systems accounting for $146.9B driven by major submarine orders. GD targets 200 annual Gulfstream aircraft deliveries by 2030 while maintaining elevated capital spending for shipyard expansion and productivity improvements.

items.title: ABBV Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Raised Outlook and Pipeline Progress
items.summary: AbbVie raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $67.8B and adjusted EPS outlook to $13.95-$13.99, driven by strong demand for immunology treatments Skyrizi and Rinvoq, which grew 22.9% and 24.3% respectively. The company also highlighted progress in its oncology pipeline with etentamig targeting a 2027 approval decision and Epkinly showing promising results in lymphoma treatment.

items.title: Marvell Just Bet $115 Billion On AI's 'Once In A Generation' Opportunity. Should You Buy The Stock?
items.summary: Marvell agreed to acquire optical-parts maker Lumentum for approximately $115 billion in an all-stock deal, with Lumentum shareholders receiving 4.5 Marvell shares per share (23.9% premium). Current Marvell shareholders will own about 67% of the combined company post-deal. Marvell stock fell over 20% since talks were reported, but the company projects $70-90 billion in revenue and $30+ EPS by fiscal 2031. The deal closes in H1 2028 and requires shareholder and regulatory approval.

items.title: C3.ai: What's Behind the Stock's Surge in the Past 3 Months?
items.summary: C3.ai stock rallied nearly 30% over three months despite weak fundamentals, including a 25% revenue decline and $92.8 million net loss. The surge lacks a clear catalyst and may reflect investor optimism around CEO Tom Siebel's return. However, the company faces growing AI competition and an unclear path to profitability, making it a risky investment.

items.title: Marvell Technology vs. SK Hynix: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: The article compares Marvell Technology and SK Hynix as investment options for 2027. Marvell provides data infrastructure and custom AI chips with strong growth visibility, targeting $12B in custom chip revenue by fiscal 2029 and $30 EPS by fiscal 2031. SK Hynix is a memory chip leader with impressive current financials but faces cyclical pricing pressures. The author recommends Marvell over SK Hynix due to more predictable revenue, less cyclical business model, and attractive valuation relative to long-term growth potential.

items.title: I Love Vertiv for 1 Reason, and It's Not the Backlog
items.summary: Vertiv's services and spares segment is emerging as a key investment driver, growing 62% year-over-year in Q3 2026. The company recently acquired King Environmental Services and PurgeRite to strengthen its maintenance and parts business. With Q3 net sales up 61% to $4.3 billion and adjusted free cash flow reaching $652 million, Vertiv offers investors a recurring revenue stream beyond its $15 billion backlog, though the stock remains below its 52-week high of $379.

items.title: ASML reports transactions under its current share buyback program
items.summary: ASML Holding N.V. reported share buyback transactions conducted between October 26-30, 2026, under its current buyback program announced on January 28, 2026. The company repurchased approximately 346,200 shares across five trading days at weighted average prices ranging from €1,424.96 to €1,493.54 per share, totaling approximately €504 million in repurchased value.

items.title: TSM Soars 33% in the Past Year: Is It a Solid Investment Proposition?
items.summary: TSM has gained 33.2% over the past year, outperforming its sector, driven by strong AI chip demand and advanced semiconductor leadership. The company reported 41.2% year-over-year revenue growth in Q3 2026 to $46.72 billion, with HPC revenues surging 22% sequentially. TSM projects 44% revenue growth for 2026 and plans $60-64 billion in capex to expand global manufacturing capacity, positioning it favorably for sustained growth.

items.title: CVX Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Venezuela Growth and Refining Gains
items.summary: Chevron reported Q3 2026 earnings beating estimates with adjusted EPS of $5.28 vs. consensus of $4.78. The company plans to double Venezuelan joint venture production to 600,000 barrels per day by 2031, achieved record U.S. refinery throughput of 1.09M barrels daily with 98% capacity utilization, and maintains $2.5B-$3B quarterly buybacks. Management emphasized AI-driven operational efficiencies, expanded exploration across 22 million acres, and disciplined capital allocation while balancing near-term execution with long-term growth.

items.title: BMY Up 3% Post Q3 Earnings: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb's stock gained 3% after Q3 earnings beat, driven by strong performance from its Growth Portfolio which generated 57% of revenues. Key growth drivers include Opdivo Qvantig, Reblozyl, Camzyos, Breyanzi, and Opdualag. However, the Legacy Portfolio faces generic competition headwinds, and upcoming loss of exclusivity for Eliquis in Europe poses risks. Recent pipeline progress in Zenbexus, admilparant, and RYZ101 offers long-term growth potential. The stock trades at a valuation discount but faces margin pressures and mixed earnings estimate revisions, warranting a cautious hold stance.

items.title: Qnity Electronics to Report Q3 Earnings: Is a Beat in Store?
items.summary: Qnity Electronics is projected to report Q3 2026 earnings of $1.18 per share (up 16.8% YoY) and revenues of $1.48 billion (up 16.3% YoY) on Nov. 4. The company, formed from DuPont's spin-off, is expected to benefit from AI-driven demand, stronger fab utilization, and advanced-node growth across its Semiconductor Technologies and Interconnect Solutions segments. With a positive Earnings ESP of +0.85% and Zacks Rank #3, the model predicts an earnings beat.

items.title: CME vs. SoFi Technologies: Which Financial Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: CME Group and SoFi Technologies represent contrasting investment strategies in the financial sector. CME dominates derivatives trading with a 62% net margin, strong cash flow, and dividend payments, while SoFi pursues aggressive growth with 28.8% revenue expansion but negative free cash flow. The author recommends CME for 2027 due to its superior profitability and shareholder returns, though both stocks have underperformed the S&P 500 over five years.

items.title: Marriott International (MAR) Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates
items.summary: Marriott International reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.02 per share, beating consensus estimates of $2.86, with a 5.59% earnings surprise. However, revenues of $7.01 billion slightly missed expectations. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. The Hotels and Motels industry ranks in the bottom 27% of Zacks industries.

items.title: Buy Vertiv on Solid Q3 Earnings Guidance to Tap Huge Price Upside
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings (VRT) reported Q3 2026 earnings that jumped 78% with net sales surging 61.2%, beating consensus estimates. The company is capitalizing on AI infrastructure demand through power and cooling solutions, global capacity expansion, and strategic collaborations. VRT raised its 2026 guidance for sales and free cash flow, with brokerage targets indicating up to 61.7% upside potential.

items.title: Idexx Laboratories (IDXX) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Idexx Laboratories reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.98 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.71, with revenues of $1.21 billion exceeding expectations. Despite consistent earnings beats over four quarters, the stock has declined 18.5% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 10.7% gain. The company holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating with favorable estimate revision trends, though near-term performance will depend on management guidance.

items.title: Prediction: Netflix Will Begin Paying a Dividend in 2027 and Beat the S&P 500 During the Next Decade
items.summary: Netflix stock has declined despite record earnings and strong free cash flow generation. The company's transition from high-growth to high-margin cash-generating business, combined with aggressive buybacks ($4.8B in Q3 2026), suggests a dividend could be implemented by 2027. At a valuation of 16.4x 2026 earnings versus S&P 500's 18.7x, Netflix appears undervalued and positioned to outperform the broader market over the next decade.

items.title: 3 Stocks That Will Move the Market This Week
items.summary: Three major earnings reports this week will shape market direction: AMD reports strong AI infrastructure growth with 42% revenue increase expected; Apple faces scrutiny as a $5 trillion company with modest 11% revenue growth guidance; and MercadoLibre navigates Latin American market volatility following Brazil's election results.

items.title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Dumped Amazon Earlier This Year and Has Begun Piling Into a Hot Tech IPO
items.summary: Greg Abel, Warren Buffett's successor as Berkshire Hathaway CEO, has significantly overhauled the company's investment portfolio. He sold Amazon after achieving triple-digit gains and has made two major investments in Bending Spoons, a tech-driven M&A platform, totaling approximately $930 million. These moves signal Abel's strong commitment to AI and tech investments, marking a notable shift in Berkshire's investment strategy.

items.title: Is SoFi Stock a Buy After its Spectacular Investor Update?
items.summary: SoFi Technologies delivered an optimistic long-term forecast that impressed investors, with the stock soaring 13% after beating estimates and raising guidance. The company's relatively conservative management team's positive outlook has sparked investor enthusiasm about the fintech company's growth prospects.

items.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Southern Copper, Freeport-McMoRan, First Quantum Minerals, Lundin Mining and Centrus Energy
items.summary: Zacks highlights five non-ferrous metal mining stocks amid industry challenges from volatile metal prices, labor shortages, and rising costs. However, strong demand from energy transition and infrastructure investments is expected to support the sector. Southern Copper and Freeport-McMoRan carry Buy ratings with strong growth prospects, while First Quantum Minerals, Lundin Mining, and Centrus Energy are rated Hold with mixed near-term outlooks.

items.title: Alphabet Missed Its Q3 Estimates, and I Couldn't Care Less
items.summary: Alphabet missed Q3 earnings and revenue estimates, with per-share profits falling 26% year-over-year and free cash flow turning negative due to massive AI infrastructure spending ($51.4B capex). However, the author argues the market is overreacting, highlighting strong fundamentals: Google Cloud revenue doubled to $30.7B, operating income grew 30%, and the company's backlog reached $567.7B (mostly AI-related). The author believes temporary headwinds and equity valuation changes are masking the company's underlying strength.

items.title: Stock Split Watch: Is Moderna Next?
items.summary: Moderna's stock has surged 650% in 2026 following a turnaround driven by cost-cutting and focus on oncology and rare disease candidates. While the biotech's personalized cancer vaccine shows promise with strong phase 3 melanoma trial results, the article suggests a stock split may not be imminent, as the current price remains accessible to investors and the company has significant growth catalysts ahead.

items.title: Can SpaceX Overcome the AI Trade Sell-Off?
items.summary: SpaceX's AI revenue surged 830% to $7.6 billion in Q3, now representing 52% of total revenue, but the company's stock remains down 5% from its IPO price. Investors are skeptical due to massive capital expenditures of $19.6 billion in the quarter (83% allocated to AI) and uncertainty about whether these investments will pay off long-term. While Starlink and space launch businesses show solid growth, SpaceX faces headwinds as the broader market questions tech companies' AI spending efficiency.

items.title: ROSEN, THE FIRST FILING FIRM, Encourages The Ensign Group, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - ENSG
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a securities class action lawsuit against The Ensign Group, Inc., alleging the company made false statements about its business operations. The lawsuit claims Ensign's business model depends on systematic neglect of elderly residents in its facilities, including inadequate food, medical attention, and basic care, resulting in deaths. Additional allegations include Medicaid/Medicare fraud, falsification of nursing assistant hours, and illegal licensing schemes. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 7, 2026.

items.title: American Tower: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: American Tower raised its full-year guidance and data center growth outlook to 16% driven by strong AI and cloud demand. The company agreed to sell its Canadian operations for $2 billion to fund buybacks and debt reduction. Management expects U.S. organic growth to accelerate in 2027 after a temporary drag from DISH Network customer churn in 2026.

items.title: Church & Dwight: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Church & Dwight reported 5.1% organic sales growth in Q3 2026, driven by higher product volume. The company is offsetting $150 million in cost inflation through record productivity gains and margin expansion. Personal care brands like THERABREATH are gaining market share, while value-tier laundry products like ARM & HAMMER are resonating with cost-conscious consumers amid economic headwinds.

items.title: Netflix Stock Is Trading at a Historically Low Valuation. Is This a Generational Buying Opportunity?
items.summary: Netflix's stock has fallen to a 10-year valuation low of 17.3x forward earnings, down from a 10-year median of 48.4x, due to lower-than-expected user engagement, reduced advertising revenue guidance, and increased competition. While the company maintains strong fundamentals with solid revenue growth and free cash flow, the author views the current valuation as fairly valued but not yet a generational buying opportunity given remaining uncertainties.

items.title: SpaceX Stock Is Nearly 30% Below Its Post-IPO High. Here's What Facebook's Stock Did From the Same Spot.
items.summary: SpaceX stock has fallen approximately 29% from its post-IPO high of $201.80 to around $144. The article compares this to Facebook's similar decline after its 2012 IPO, noting that Facebook recovered only after demonstrating strong mobile ad revenue growth. SpaceX faces different challenges with massive capital spending on AI and other ventures, and investors should wait for the company to meet its Q1 2027 revenue guidance before considering it a buy.

items.title: ASTS DEADLINE: ROSEN, NATIONAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - ASTS
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces a securities class action lawsuit against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding capital requirements, liquidity position, competitive standing, and user adoption rates during the Class Period from March 4, 2025 to July 15, 2026. Investors have until November 13, 2026 to serve as lead plaintiff.

items.title: BAIDU DEADLINE: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Baidu, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BIDU
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces a securities class action lawsuit against Baidu, Inc. for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its AI business's ability to offset declines in its legacy online marketing business. Investors who purchased Baidu securities between November 18, 2025 and August 17, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 13, 2026.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Bank of America Corporation (NYSE: BAC) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America Corporation for alleged securities fraud related to systemic weaknesses in its Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering compliance program. The lawsuit claims BAC failed to properly monitor trillions of dollars in transactions and made false statements about its compliance efforts and remediation progress following a 2024 Consent Order. Investors who purchased BAC securities between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 15, 2026.

items.title: Copper Is Priced Like an AI Stock Now. What the Sell-off Means for Freeport-McMoRan.
items.summary: Copper prices have surged 71% since early 2024 to $6.67 per pound, driven by AI data center expansion and industrial reshoring. Freeport-McMoRan's operating income grew 19% in Q3 with strong copper sales, though the stock has fallen 18% recently. With global copper demand projected to increase 50% by 2040, the recent sell-off may present a buying opportunity for long-term investors despite near-term volatility tied to hyperscaler capital expenditure trends.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. (NASDAQ: HONA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm.
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA) alleging that the company made materially false statements and failed to disclose material adverse facts during the period of June 29, 2026 to September 1, 2026. The complaint alleges undisclosed supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, a false Claims Act investigation related to cybersecurity compliance on government contracts, and misleading statements about business prospects. Investors who purchased securities during the class period may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 23, 2026.

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false statements about its capital requirements, competitive position in the satellite direct-to-cell market, and user adoption rates between March 4, 2025 and July 15, 2026. Investors who purchased AST SpaceMobile securities during this period are encouraged to join the case.

items.title: HIMS Deadline in 1 Day: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS) Class Action Lawsuit Seeks Recovery for Investors; November 2, 2026 Deadline- Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP
items.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. for material misstatements regarding deceptive privacy practices. The FTC accused HIMS of sharing customers' medical information with third-party advertisers including Meta and Snap. Following the FTC lawsuit announcement on July 29, 2026, HIMS stock declined 14.73%. Investors have until November 2, 2026, to file for lead plaintiff status.

items.title: The First U.S. Humanoid Robot Stock Starts Trading in November. Here's Why I'd Wait for the De-SPAC Dip.
items.summary: Agility Robotics will go public in November through a SPAC merger with Churchill Capital XI, valuing the company at $2.5 billion. The article advises investors to wait for post-listing volatility to subside before buying, as new high-profile stocks typically experience profit-taking in the initial weeks following their debut.

items.title: Alphabet Says Its AI Spending Will Keep Rising. 2 Data Center Stocks to Buy and Hold Through 2030.
items.summary: Alphabet plans to significantly increase its AI infrastructure spending in 2027, building on its $51.4 billion Q3 2026 capital expenditure. The article recommends two data center suppliers—Nvidia and Vertiv—as long-term holds through 2030, despite both trading below recent highs. Nvidia trades at a lower valuation multiple (14x forward earnings) compared to Vertiv (26x), making it the more attractive entry point for new investors.

items.title: Why the 27% Crash in ServiceNow's Stock Looks Like a Golden Opportunity
items.summary: ServiceNow's stock plunged 27% following Q3 earnings despite solid fundamentals: 20.5% revenue growth to $4.11B and subscription revenue up 21%. The sell-off appears to be an overreaction driven by smaller-than-typical earnings beat and modest guidance. The company is well-positioned in AI with 65% YoY growth in AI annual contract value and strong partnerships with OpenAI. At a forward P/S of 6x and P/E of 22x, the stock presents an attractive buying opportunity for long-term investors.

items.title: Medtronic Just Retired 55 Million Shares Without Spending Cash. Is the Stock a Buy?
items.summary: Medtronic completed a spinoff of its diabetes segment (MiniMed) and retired 55 million shares without cash expenditure, which will boost future EPS. The company reported strong Q1 FY2027 results with 14% revenue growth and is approaching Dividend King status (49 consecutive years of increases). Despite operational improvements and a reinvigorated pipeline with 50+ FDA approvals, Medtronic trades at a discount to medtech peers.

items.title: Vertiv: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Vertiv reported Q3 2026 net sales of $4.3 billion with organic order growth exceeding 100% year-over-year, driven by surging AI infrastructure demand. The company's modular infrastructure reduces data center deployment time by up to half, and management is aggressively reinvesting in manufacturing capacity while maintaining high profitability. Vertiv raised full-year net sales guidance to $14.7 billion.

items.title: Fortinet: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Fortinet raised its full-year 2026 billings guidance following strong Q3 earnings, driven by accelerating large enterprise deals (51% growth for deals over $1M), expanding SASE platform adoption (31% YoY growth), and surging operational technology billings (nearly 40% growth). The company is positioned to benefit from growing AI-driven cybersecurity threats and expects 2027 revenue growth to outpace its addressable market.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Shares Just Rallied to Their Highest Level Since Warren Buffett Announced He Would Step Down as CEO, Closing Within 1.5% of Their All-Time High. Does That Rally Validate His Succession Plan?
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway stock has recovered to near all-time highs approximately 10 months after Warren Buffett handed over the CEO role to Greg Abel. While the recovery might suggest validation of the succession plan, the article argues it more likely reflects investor appreciation for the company's diversified business model, reliable cash flows, and substantial $350 billion cash position amid broader market concerns about an AI bubble.

items.title: FedEx: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: FedEx raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance following strong Q3 2026 earnings. The company is executing Network 2.0 optimization targeting $2 billion in cumulative savings by 2027, accelerating share buybacks as free cash flow expands, and strategically shifting toward higher-margin B2B and international cargo while shedding low-margin domestic shipments. International export volume grew 8% year-over-year, supporting margin expansion.

items.title: 3 Numbers to Watch to Know if Meta Platforms' AI Spending Is Paying Off
items.summary: Meta Platforms is investing heavily in AI with $135-145 billion planned capex for 2026, but investors should monitor three key metrics: advertising revenue growth (currently up 25.9% YoY), monetization of new AI products like Muse agent, and operating cash flow trends. While OCF grew 21.7% YoY, it's lagging capex growth of 72%, resulting in negative free cash flow of $2.1 billion in Q3 2026.

items.title: Sandisk: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Sandisk reported Q1 2027 revenue of $11 billion, up 378% year-over-year, driven by surging AI-related data center demand for NAND flash memory. The company secured long-term customer contracts through 2030, with data center applications now representing half of industry memory demand. With $5.1 billion in cash and zero debt, Sandisk returned excess cash to shareholders through $5 billion in share repurchases and announced an 8-for-1 stock split.

items.title: Digital Realty: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Digital Realty reported record Q3 2026 results with $855 million in quarterly leasing bookings and raised full-year core FFO guidance. The company achieved record contracted backlog of $2.5 billion ($1.8 billion at company share), providing multiyear revenue visibility through 2028. Strong enterprise demand for AI infrastructure and smaller data center deployments (under 1 megawatt) drove 80% year-over-year growth, while strategic private capital partnerships enable scaling without dilution or excessive leverage.

items.title: Intel Has a Massive Warning for AMD Stock Investors. Is It Time to Book Profits Before Nov. 3?
items.summary: Intel's weak Q3 guidance and 28% stock crash due to declining PC sales raises concerns for AMD investors ahead of its Nov. 3 earnings report. However, AMD may outperform Intel due to market share gains in both client and server CPUs, making any post-earnings dip a potential buying opportunity given its strong growth prospects and reasonable valuation.

items.title: Starbucks: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Starbucks reported strong Q4 2026 earnings with full-year EPS exceeding targets, driven by five consecutive quarters of same-store sales growth (7.2% in Q4) under its Back to Starbucks turnaround plan. Operating margins expanded to 14% through operational streamlining and supply chain efficiencies, with over 50% of a $2 billion cost-savings program achieved. The company completed 1,700+ store uplifts across North America, with 80%+ of renovated stores showing positive same-store sales, and plans to continue prioritizing store renovations, dividend increases, and share repurchases.

items.title: APPLOVIN DEADLINE: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm is seeking lead plaintiffs for a securities class action lawsuit against AppLovin Corporation. The lawsuit alleges that AppLovin made false and misleading statements regarding its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition during the Class Period from February 12, 2026 to August 5, 2026. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to secure counsel before the November 16, 2026 deadline.

items.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages D-Wave Quantum Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – QBTS
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm is urging D-Wave Quantum Inc. investors who purchased securities between February 26, 2026 and August 25, 2026 to join a securities class action lawsuit before the December 15, 2026 deadline. The lawsuit alleges that D-Wave made materially false statements about its bookings, commercial adoption, and revenue projections, claiming that purported record 2026 bookings consisted mainly of contracts signed before the class period and that system deliveries were slipping into late 2026 and 2027.

items.title: Colgate-Palmolive: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive reported Q3 2026 earnings with broad-based organic sales growth across four of five divisions. The company is leveraging dynamic pricing and cost-reduction programs to offset persistent raw material inflation while maintaining operating margins. Premium product innovation in Hill's Pet Nutrition is driving market share gains, and management remains optimistic about long-term growth prospects supported by revenue growth management and AI tools.

items.title: TFI International: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: TFI International reported Q3 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $1.67 and $116 million in free cash flow. The company is improving truckload profitability through asset efficiency, addressing operational challenges in its U.S. less-than-truckload business through management changes, and expanding its high-margin asset-light logistics segment. Management expects favorable conditions in 2027 as demand recovers while industry fleet supply remains constrained.

items.title: Webull Corporation (BULL) Class Action Lawsuit Seeks Recovery for Investors; December 7, 2026 Deadline- Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP
items.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) for allegedly making material misstatements about its relationship with China. The company falsely represented its China operations as limited to R&D and technical support, when in reality its core platform, software development, and 62% of its global workforce were China-based. Following a CNBC report on October 7, 2026, Webull's stock fell approximately 19%. Investors have until December 7, 2026, to file for lead plaintiff status.

items.title: Stock-Split Watch: GE Vernova Trades Above $890 With a $176 Billion Backlog. Is a Split Next?
items.summary: GE Vernova trades at $890 per share with a $237 billion market cap, prompting speculation about a potential stock split. The company reported strong Q3 results with 96% organic order growth and a $197 billion backlog, though management is currently focused on share buybacks rather than splits. A split may occur if the stock price sustains above $1,000 per share.

items.title: Q3 Earnings: 2 Dates Every Space Investor Needs to Circle
items.summary: Three major space companies are reporting Q3 2026 earnings in early November. Rocket Lab and AST SpaceMobile report on Nov. 9, with Rocket Lab facing scrutiny over its delayed Neutron rocket launch and ASTS dealing with consecutive EPS misses. Firefly Aerospace reports on Nov. 10 after posting record Q2 revenue but facing margin compression concerns.

items.title: Amazon Plans to Spend More on AI. Here’s Why the Stock is a Once-in-a-Decade Buy Hiding in Plain Sight.
items.summary: Amazon reported Q3 earnings that missed estimates and announced plans to increase AI spending beyond its $220 billion annual capital expenditure forecast. Despite negative free cash flow of $42 billion in the trailing 12 months, CEO Andy Jassy expressed confidence in achieving attractive financial returns, predicting AWS could become a trillion-dollar revenue business within 5-10 years. The article argues Amazon stock, down 14% from August highs and trading at 30x forward earnings, represents a compelling long-term buying opportunity despite near-term cash flow pressures.
